info.title: judge: admin and auth API

get.description:
Newest first. action=contest. is every contest.* action; console=true: only what the console did,
console=false: only the web; since <= at < until.

parameters.description: exact, or a prefix ending with '.'
parameters.name: action

schema.description: exact, or a prefix ending with '.'
schema.title: Action

get.description:
The inbox: every thread with comments, the one with the newest comment first (the cursor is that comment's
id). awaiting: the last comment not deleted is a student's; unread: for this admin; group_id: private threads
of its current members and shared threads of items addressed to it.

post.description:
Soft: students no longer see it, teachers see the text, who deleted it and the reason. The answer is the
deleted comment with its item and thread. Again: 409 already_deleted.

put.description: Create or change a contest from the JSON form of contest.yaml (same schema, same rules, same apply).

post.description: 201 for a new extension; 200 when it replaced one of the same student or group (`replaced`: the old due).
Only an extension of this very problem of this contest: an id of another one is 404, like a missing one.

get.description: Groups not archived by default; archived=true: only archived ones; archived=all: every group.
Students now (history=true: also those removed, with when), and the contests it is attached to.

The items addressed to the group, in the order of the feed (available_from, else published_at; newest
first). No cursor: one group's feed.

Newest first by id. group_id: addressed to the group; kind: assignment | contest; state: draft | published |
archived.

post.description: A draft with its audience in one transaction (a refused addressee leaves no item).

get.description:
Every setting, the contest, the audience by name, the number of extensions, works by status, `warning` (a
contest item whose addressees may not see the contest).

put.description: Only the keys sent change; null clears. grading pass_fail / none without max_points clears max_points.

post.description: Gone from the feed, refuses hand-ins; students keep their work and released grades.

get.description: The files (id, name, size, sha256) and links (id, url, title) of the item, in their order.

post.description:
A file attachment, appended: the raw body (application/octet-stream), the name in ?name=. 201 with the
attachment. 415 another Content-Type; 422 invalid_request (no name, twice, broken UTF-8), file_type_not_allowed,
file_content_mismatch, file_empty, duplicate_name; 409 item_archived, too_many_attachments; 413 too_large (more
than JUDGE_ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB, before the service).

parameters.description: the file name with its extension, UTF-8 percent-encoded (encodeURIComponent)
parameters.name: name

put.description:
{ids}: every attachment of the item exactly once (attachment_order_invalid otherwise, with missing, extra and
repeated). The attachments in the new order.

get.description:
The file of a file attachment of this item (docs/FILES.md: the type by name and content, ETag, 304). 404
attachment_not_found: no such attachment of this item (another item's included) or a link.

post.description:
Remove an attachment of this item (the blob stays; the audit keeps name, sha256 and size, or url and title).
Another item's id: 404 attachment_not_found.

put.description: The audience becomes exactly these groups and students: {item, added, removed}.

get.description:
Oldest first, deleted comments with their text and reason; `unread` is this admin's. Reading sets no mark
(POST …/read does). thread_id null: nobody has written yet.

post.description: A teacher writes even with comments off and in a contest item; not in a draft (not_published).
This admin's mark: up to `up_to` or the last comment; it only grows. {unread}: what is left.
Only a draft without works and extensions; {confirm_id} must repeat the id.
201 for a new extension; 200 when it replaced one of the same student or group (`replaced`: the old due).
Only an extension of this item: the id of another one (of a contest problem too) is 404, like a missing one.
A link attachment, appended: stored as sent after strip (a blank title: none); the server never opens it.
Needs an addressee; with a future available_from the students see it from then (no scheduler).

Release the current grades of every work of the item, or of these students: one result per student -
released, nothing_to_release (no work or not graded) or already_released. Unknown user_ids: 404 before
anything changes; release_not_needed (immediate or grading none): 409 for the whole call.

get.description:
The thread of the pair (item, student) of the path: an assignment and a student addressed now or with work
or a thread there, else 404 thread_not_found.

post.description: A reply or the first message to the student (the thread is made by it); archived items too.

get.description:
Every hand-in with its text answer, every review (unreleased grades too), the cached status, what the student
sees, missing. An addressee without work: status assigned, no events (a grade can be given from here). 404
work_not_found: not addressed and no work on this item.

One file of the work of (item, student) - an upload or the text answer answer.md (the ids are in the card:
events[].files) - served by content_files.file_response (docs/FILES.md: the type by name and content, ETag, 304)
after works.work_file found it by the pair of the path: a file of another student's or item's work is 404
file_not_found, like a missing one. The text answer is served as text (text=True).

post.description: Back for rework with a comment: the student sees it at once and may hand in again.

get.description:
The library as an admin sees it: {sections: [{id, title, materials, sections}], unsorted} - every section and
material, archived ones marked. ?q=: {query, materials} - the search by title, any case (Cyrillic too), with %,
_ and \ taken literally.

post.description:
A section at the end of the top level, or with parent_id a subsection at the end of a top-level section (409
section_too_deep under a subsection). 422 section_title_invalid.

put.description:
The order of the top level (parent_id null) or of the subsections of a section: every one exactly once (422
order_invalid with missing, extra and repeated).

patch.description: A new title. changed false: the same one.

post.description:
Delete a section without subsections (409 section_not_empty); its materials only leave it. confirm_id: the
id again (422 confirmation_mismatch). What was deleted, with the slugs that were in it.
Put a material at the end of the section (changed false: it is there). 409 material_archived.

put.description: {ids}: the material ids of the section, every one exactly once (422 order_invalid).

post.description: Take a material out of the section (it stays in the library). changed false: it was not there.

To the end of a top-level section (parent_id) or of the top level (null). 422 section_invalid (under itself);
409 section_too_deep (under a subsection, or a section with subsections under another).
Any login, also one that does not exist (failures are counted for those too); not an admin's.

get.description:
Newest first by id: slug, title, library audience and groups, sections, number of versions. archived=true:
archived ones too.

post.description:
A material and its version 1 (with its library groups in one transaction). 409 slug_taken (archived ones
too); 422 slug_invalid, title_invalid, body_invalid, body_too_long, library_invalid. The material as GET answers
it, plus `warnings` about the links of the text.

The links [[памятка:slug]] of a text as they would be saved: `links` - one per distinct slug, status ok,
archived or unknown (with id and title when the material exists); `warnings` - what judgectl prints. Writes
nothing.

get.description:
The latest version: text, attachments, its links resolved (ok / archived / unknown) and `link_warnings`; the
library audience, groups, sections, number of versions, archived_at.

patch.description:
The title and the library audience, in place (no version). A slug other than the current one: 422
slug_immutable (create a new material and archive this one). 409 material_archived.

post.description: Read only and out of the library; the feed and links still open it. Again: changed false.

A new version with this file appended: the raw body (application/octet-stream), the name in ?name=. 201 with
the version and its attachments. 415 another Content-Type; 422 invalid_request (no name, twice, broken UTF-8),
file_type_not_allowed, file_content_mismatch, file_empty, duplicate_name; 404 material_not_found; 409
material_archived, too_many_attachments; 413 too_large (more than JUDGE_ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB, before the service).

parameters.description: the file name with its extension, UTF-8 percent-encoded (encodeURIComponent)
parameters.name: name

put.description:
{ids}: every attachment of the latest version exactly once (attachment_order_invalid otherwise, with missing,
extra and repeated). A new version in this order (`created`: false for the same order).

get.description:
The file of a file attachment of the latest version, or of ?version=N (docs/FILES.md: the type by name and
content, ETag, 304). 404 attachment_not_found (not a file of that version: another version's, a link, no such
id), version_not_found.

post.description:
A new version without this attachment of the latest one (the blob stays with the old versions). 404
attachment_not_found: not one of the latest version.

put.description:
The library groups: exactly these (they count with library groups). A group added must not be archived (409
group_archived); one already there stays. 409 material_archived.

post.description: A new version with this link appended (stored after strip; the server never opens it).
Back from the archive (its sections were kept). Again: changed false.

get.description: Every version, newest first: number, when, who, length of the text, number of attachments.

post.description:
A new text: a new version with the attachments of the latest one (`created`: false and the latest version
when the text is the same). `warnings` about its links. 409 material_archived; 422 body_invalid, body_too_long.

get.description: One version: its text, attachments and links resolved now. 404 version_not_found.

Material items of it, feed items linking it, problem versions linking it (slug@version), materials whose
latest version links it.
The admin behind this session (and its CSRF token): the first call of the admin web UI.
Active problems by default; archived=true: only archived ones; archived=all: every problem.

post.description: The body is the zip of a package (application/zip). 201 created; 200 exists (the same content) or dry run.

get.description: One file of the package (a test, the statement, a picture), looked up only among the version's files.

post.description:
Check the version again with a worker (D-054). 202: queued; 200: a check is already queued or running
(nothing new). The status of the version changes only when the check ends.

get.description: Newest first. verdict and status: of the current judgement; group_id: its current members.

post.description: Two steps: {dry_run: true} answers {affected}; then the same filter with expect: affected does it.

get.description:
The source (text up to 256 KB, or the names in an archive), every judgement, and every test of the current
judgement (or of judgement_id), hidden tests included.
A single file as text/plain, an archive as application/zip, always an attachment (never a page).
Migrations, load (what students see), queue metrics, workers, configuration: one moment of the database.

post.description: The body is the class list itself (text/csv, at most 1 MB): all or nothing, every bad line reported.
One-time login links for a list of students (cards with QR codes are printed by the web UI, module 5).

put.description: The zone the web shows a student's times in; an admin sets their own through PUT /api/auth/profile.

get.description:
With item_id: every student addressed now and everyone with work on it (assigned: no work yet), the cursor is
the user id; without: only works that exist, on every assignment, the cursor is the work id (missing needs
item_id). group_id: its current members; late: of the latest hand-in; missing: nothing handed in, due passed.

post.description: Students get an active session; admins an `mfa_pending` one that only allows /totp and /logout.
Revokes the session (CSRF token required). Without a live session it only clears the cookie.

The current password (admins: and a TOTP code) is required; other sessions are revoked and this one
gets a new token. A new password against the rules answers 422 password_policy with a message for the user.

put.description:
Any fully logged-in user, students too, changes their own time zone (D-024): the user is the one of the
session, never one named in the body. An unknown zone answers 422 timezone_invalid and changes nothing.

post.description: Login by a one-time QR token (students only); the frontend posts the token from the URL fragment.
Second step of an admin login: the session becomes active under a new token (and a new CSRF token).
